call_points.text: FY27 net store addition guidance maintained at 800, including franchisee stores.
Full-year margin guidance deferred; management asked for one quarter before projecting FY27.
Board-approved food park and wellness capex put on hold; funds to be redeployed.
Gross margin fell 200 bps QoQ: 100 bps private-label mix, 70 bps inventory provision, 40 bps supplier discount.
Private label pharma absolute sales flat YoY at ₹197 Cr vs ₹200 Cr; share fell 200 bps.
Promoter debt against pledged shares ~₹1,150 Cr; no timeline to reduce.
Diagnostics profitable but below target; no significant radiology expansion planned.
